newsitem.title: UK: Four of five Brent dates clocked, one kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: Four of five Brent dates clocked, one kept - trade.

text.p: Four of the five Brent dates nominated from the paper chains on Friday were clocked, while the other was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
Shell UK, Mobil, Koch and Glencore were clocked with a cargo each, with loading dates between March 22-26. BP kept a cargo which was deferred on Thursday to March 23-25 loading dates.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
